prompts_identical_across_all_5_runs.format_source: Official Wan-Animate-2 upstream convention (Wan-Video/Wan-Animate-2 README): two labeled sections, 'Character appearance description: ...' and 'Background description: ...', combined into one string, objective/factual, no action or emotional speculation. `pose_prompt` is a separate field (feeds `positive_pose`, per WanAnimate2ToVideo's own tooltip: 'describing the motion rather than the character') -- written the same objective style but describing only the driving clip's motion.
prompts_identical_across_all_5_runs.never_use_template_demo_defaults: The shipped template ships with demo placeholder text (a pink-hair character / street-dance description) in the Comfy Cloud UI -- this is a hosted-template onboarding default, not found in the raw blueprint JSON's own widgets_values (which are empty strings there). Fully clear/overwrite both fields; do not leave any demo text concatenated with the text above.

length_semantics_verified_from_source.if_driving_frames_greater_than_length: Truncated: `pose_video = pose_video[video_frame_offset:][:length]` -- only the first `length` frames of the driving clip are used, no error.
length_semantics_verified_from_source.if_driving_frames_less_than_length: Padded by holding the last frame: `pose_video = torch.cat((pose_video,) + (pose_video[-1:],) * (length - pose_video.shape[0]), dim=0)` -- the tail is a frozen repeat of the last real frame, not new motion. No error, but the padded tail dilutes any motion measurement across the full `length`.
length_semantics_verified_from_source.conclusion: No crash either way; length is not hard-constrained to multiples of 4 despite the UI 'step=4' (that is a spinner-increment nicety, not a validated constraint in execute()) -- any positive integer is legal. Chose length=60 (not the 81 default) for runs 1-4 specifically to avoid a 21-frame frozen-tail diluting root_translation_fraction; chose length=13 for run 5, which truncates the SAME 60-frame driving file to its first 13 frames via this same mechanism -- no separate short driving asset is needed.

seeds.derivation: First 14 and next 14 hex chars of the frozen driving video's SHA-256, interpreted as integers -- deterministic and reproducible, fixed before any generation, not chosen after seeing any output.
seeds.sampler_mode: fixed (control_after_generate='fixed', NOT 'randomize' -- the official templates default to 'randomize' and must be overridden per run)

cache_off_procedure_for_run_5.why_the_exposed_widgets_cannot_do_it: Verified from comfy_extras/nodes_wan.py, class WanAnimate2Cache.define_schema(): `device` combo options are exactly ['cpu','gpu'] (no 'off'/'none'); `dtype` combo options are exactly ['default','int8','int4']. The node ALWAYS attaches a PoseBranchCache to the model when present in the graph -- there is no widget value that disables it. True cache-OFF requires removing it from the execution path.
steps: 1. Open (double-click, or right-click -> Open Subgraph/Enter) the 'Motion Transfer (Wan Animate 2)' subgraph node for the Distilled workflow.
2. Inside it, locate the node named WanAnimate2Cache (sits between the model/LoRA loader chain and the sampler; single MODEL input, single MODEL output).
3. Click to select only that node.
4. Right-click -> 'Bypass' (or select it and press Ctrl+B). It should render muted/dashed, indicating it is now a passthrough.
5. Visually confirm the MODEL connection now effectively skips it (ComfyUI auto-routes a bypassed single-in/single-out node's matching-type wire straight through).
6. Exit back to the top-level graph.
7. Leave the outer cache_device/cache_dtype widgets at their shipped defaults -- once bypassed, the node that would read them never executes, so their values are inert.

second_subgraph: The template ships a second 'Motion Transfer' subgraph, bypassed by default. Leave it bypassed for all 5 runs -- it is not part of this pre-registered matrix; do not enable, connect, or run it.

Deviations from shipped defaults are: prompt/pose_prompt (shipped empty/demo -> pre-registered text above), length (shipped 81 -> 60 for runs 1-4, 13 for run 5, reasoned above), seed control (shipped randomize -> fixed), and run 5's cache bypass. output_files_needed_per_run.both_required: The plain generated clip AND the side-by-side comparison video the graph also saves.
output_files_needed_per_run.why_both: The generated clip alone is required for the detector-based scorer (tracking.py) -- a side-by-side composite doubles the frame width and puts the driving clip's own subject in the same frame, which would corrupt the person-detector's box coordinates and could register as a false 'ghost' detection. The side-by-side is for Rob's own human-verdict-gate visual review convenience only; the scorer never reads it.

post_return_validation: Before scoring, check each returned file's embedded workflow metadata (if ComfyUI embedded it) and Rob's exported workflow JSON against this manifest -- confirm actual checkpoint, seed, length, and cache-bypass state match what was pre-registered here before treating any output as valid evidence. A mismatch is reported, not silently scored.
stop_rule: If credits run out, stop in table order (1,2,3,4,5) and report what completed. No paid top-up.
cache_note: The shipped WanAnimate2Cache stores activations as lossy int8 in the PoseBranchCache -- runs 1-4 use this shipped default as-is; only run 5 removes the node from the graph entirely.
